hooks.command: jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty' | { read -r f; case "$f" in */ARCHITECTURE.md|""|*/node_modules/*|*/.git/*) exit 0 ;; esac; jq -n --arg f "$f" '{hookSpecificOutput: {hookEventName: "PostToolUse", additionalContext: ("Reminder: " + $f + " was just modified. If this changes what a file does, or adds/removes/renames a file, update ARCHITECTURE.md accordingly.")}}'; } 2>/dev/null
hooks.statusMessage: Checking if ARCHITECTURE.md needs an update...
